gbm_population_evidence.quote: Males and females at least 18 years of age on the day of signing informed consent with histopathologic evidence of GBM (from original or recurrent diagnosis) and MRI-confirmed diagnosis of rGBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: to assess the effectiveness of pembrolizumab and lenvatinib combination therapy for recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM) patients wearing TTFields electrodes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Lenvatinib, Pembrolizumab, and Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) for Second-line Treatment of Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Lenvatinib (other names: LENVIMA®, KISPLYX®): Oral Lenvatinib 20 mg once daily

agents.drug_class_hint: multikinase (VEGFR/FGFR) inhibitor approved in thyroid, renal, hepatocellular and endometrial cancer

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab (other names: Keytruda): intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every three weeks

coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1/2 in recurrent GBM: lenvatinib + pembrolizumab with TTFields (device, not an agent). Patients may or may not have had first-line TTFields; TTFields is part of the experimental regimen but not an agent. Archival tissue is required but no biomarker is named.
